The first approach cannot tell "this result"},{"id":"p7s4","text":" is large but I still need it" from "this one is spent", and the second one invites summary hallucin"},{"id":"p7s5","text":"rge but I still need it" from "this one is spent", and the second one invites summary hallucination."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"This plugin replaces the decision in both places with Jev's structured output (`noul` / `choice`, re"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"turning calibrated probabilities), under one design rule:"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"> **What should not be generated by a model is not generated by a model.** Trimming only ever decide"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"s *keep* or *discard*; the original text is preserved verbatim. Region compaction injects a **determ"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"inistic receipt** produced by code, containing no model inference at all."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## The two layers"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"| Layer | Interception point | DSH default | This plugin |"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"| **1 · Result trimming** | `ctx.toolResultPruner.pruneSession` | Chops the middle once `thresholdCh"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"ars` is exceeded | Jev decides, per tool result, whether it will still be needed. | **2 · Receipt"},{"id":"p12s5","text":" compaction** | `ctx.compaction.summarize` + `compactRegion`, or a single-result surface replacement"},{"id":"p12s6","text":" for mixed batches | The model reads the raw history and writes a summary | Moves fully eligible rea"},{"id":"p12s7","text":"d-only steps out of the surface. In a parallel batch where only some results qualify, it keeps every"},{"id":"p12s8","text":" call/result envelope and replaces only the eligible result bodies with **deterministic receipts**. Report token classes separately: the cache-hit share of input is high ("},{"id":"p20s4","text":"78–94%) and hit/miss prices differ by ~50×, so total-token comparisons mislead by design."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"**Fewer destructive compactions — some of them receipts instead of summaries.** Per completed long r"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"un, DSH's own model-written summary compactions dropped from 31–40 (baseline) to 15–23 with the full"},{"id":"p21s3","text":" plugin, of which 6–8 were replaced by deterministic receipts rendered by code. "},{"id":"p24s2","text":"Every one of the following must hold:"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"- **Intersection of two axes**: `result` (is the content still needed) and `effect` (did the call ch"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"ange state outside the session) must *each* fall inside this session's trailing `compactQuantile`
